assets.notes: Celestial chart for /manifesto (brief 7.B). Full-width 1600x1000 (an 800x500 version for mobile), already faint (ink at 20 % over the ground): use as a cover background at opacity 1 behind the text. No constellation names or numbers by construction. Day ground = --bench-c-parchment, night ground = --bench-c-cyanotype. Drawn as SVG.
